With 3 open slots and cash above the deployment threshold, we filled all three with the top fully-confirmed momentum candidates (SYRE, HIMS, HPE), each showing MACD bullish crossover, healthy RSI, price above SMA-20, and volume surge together.

market_education.summary_en: Equities drifted higher today with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500, consistent with a broad risk-on tone rather than any single catalyst. No specific news headlines were available in today's feed to attribute the move to a particular event. The gains were modest but broad enough to support selective new positions in stocks showing strong technical confirmation.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和上揚，納指升幅跑贏標普500指數，反映市場整體風險偏好回升，而非單一消息推動。今日新聞資訊中未有具體頭條可供引用解釋今次升勢。升幅雖屬溫和，但已足夠支持在技術面確認強勁的個股上作出精選買入。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: When multiple technical indicators — like a MACD bullish crossover, healthy RSI, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — all line up together, it suggests real buying interest rather than a random price blip. Waiting for this kind of confluence before buying helps avoid chasing false signals.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 當多個技術指標— 例如MACD黃金交叉、健康的RSI水平、股價高於均線，以及成交量激增 — 同時出現時，代表市場有真實的買盤支持，而非隨機波動。等待這種多重訊號確認後才入市，有助避免追逐假訊號。
